items.stem: A generated answer cites a very specific source that does not exist. What has happened?

options.text: The model hallucinated a plausible-sounding but fabricated citation
options.rationale: Correct: models can generate convincing but false references.

options.text: The source was deleted from the internet moments ago
options.rationale: The model does not fetch live sources; it generated the text.

options.text: The model made a typo in an otherwise real citation
options.rationale: The reference does not exist at all; this is fabrication, not a typo.

options.text: The citation must be real because it is detailed
options.rationale: Detail is not evidence of truth for generated text.

items.explanation: Correct: models can generate convincing but false references.

items.stem: When is a disclosure that AI assisted the work most clearly warranted?

options.text: When the output is used in a decision that affects others and accuracy matters
options.rationale: Correct: transparency supports accountability in consequential use.

options.text: Only when the AI is wrong
options.rationale: Disclosure is about transparency, not only error.

options.text: Never, because it undermines the work
options.rationale: Disclosure supports, not undermines, responsible use.
